name: zeroapi
description: ZeroAPI - transparent subscription-aware model and account routing for OpenClaw

compat.notes: Model/provider routing is fully compatible. Auth-profile/account choices are persisted through OpenClaw's public session-store API across the v2026.7.1-2 JSON layout and newer SQLite layout. Upstream before_model_resolve does not expose a same-turn authProfileOverride result field; same-turn selection still requires a compatible host extension.
